does_not_rewrite: the original COMP-015 hypothesis or frozen success rule
the completed seed-1 and seed-2 control artifacts
decision: Stop new COMP-015 training after obtaining the complete seed-1 pair. Score that already-complete pair as a cheap replication, but do not finish the seed-2 augmented treatment. Move back to single-seed screens for new interventions and add training repeats only after a result is promising.
rationale: The project is still selecting and debugging the learning process, so the immediate decision is whether to try the next intervention, not whether to make a publication-grade augmentation claim.
Seed 0 already makes COMP-015's strict all-three-pair success rule impossible and fails its behaviour gate.
COMP-016 independently confirms that seed 0's failure is a real move-choice and positional-shortcut failure rather than a complete-JSON scoring artefact.
A second complete pair now exists and can cheaply test whether seed 0 was grossly idiosyncratic. A third pair has low expected decision value before any promising treatment exists.
Multiple training seeds remain required before a positive result is treated as robust, used for a final-cohort claim, or promoted as the competence method.

preserved_unpaired_seed2_control.interpretation: No paired COMP-015 seed-2 conclusion is permitted. This completed control may be reused prospectively only under a separately frozen comparison whose exact schedule and training contract match.

stopped_seed2_augmented_attempt.process_termination: SIGTERM after the user challenged the value of further training seeds
stopped_seed2_augmented_attempt.interpretation: Preparation provenance only; this is not a trained arm and must not be evaluated or counted.

sequential_seed_policy.fast_screen: one training seed on the smallest diagnostic that can falsify the idea
sequential_seed_policy.full_development_screen: one training seed first; stop on a clear failure
sequential_seed_policy.first_replication: add a second training seed only after a promising or ambiguous first result, or when an already-complete paired artifact makes the check cheap
sequential_seed_policy.robust_claim: require additional frozen training repeats before final-cohort release or a substantive competence claim
sequential_seed_policy.generation_sampling: multiple stochastic rollouts per fixed fight answer a different question and may still be needed to estimate play outcomes for one trained model

next_action: Score the complete seed-1 pair with the float32 direct train/development/cyclic battery, document it as a bounded replication, then proceed to the no-native-thinking output comparison and single-seed weight-8 screen.
